name: native-capture-readiness
goal: Native evidence captures only after the expected Designs page, commit, approval and decoded images are ready

evidence: Root review of sealed a3: native-approved shows 'Loading design image' and 'Preview unavailable'; native-history is the Pages catalog. Root cause: a3 native-desktop.spec.ts capture() called desktopEvidence first and waited for images only under TAKE_SCREENSHOT, swallowing decode errors; history captured right after the Review designs click. Prior: captures meant to show settled Designs states.

Guard test/native-capture-order.test.ts (sha d0730836) unchanged, run against the a3 capture body (a3 spec lines 34-50 verbatim, sha e335958a) by a vitest load-hook swap under node_modules/.cache (config sha 66fe4b17), tree untouched: 6/6 fail on assertions, e.g. expected [ready:history, evidence:history], received [evidence:history]; decode failure not propagated. Command: bun x vitest run --config node_modules/.cache/native-capture-red/vitest.config.ts. Log: work/harness-remote-mobile/native-capture/red-unit/red-a3-capture-order.log

Repair: nativeCapture runs nativeReady before desktopEvidence and the optional screenshot. nativeReady asserts URL, h1, Designs aria-current, Commit value and tip/historical note, approval enabled/approved/disabled, main image and v001 thumbnail visible, complete, positive natural size, decode() without catch, no loading/unavailable text. Guard: call-order unit test.

New tests/e2e/native-readiness.ts (sha 3114b418), tests/e2e/native-capture.ts (sha d146c67f), test/native-capture-order.test.ts (sha d0730836). native-desktop.spec.ts (sha 7bf1b607): capture() removed; draft capture moved after its existing assertions; history capture after the existing toBeDisabled. No assertion, timeout, fixture, production, scenario or packaging change. Guard runs in desktop vitest (test/**/*.test.ts).

Same guard on repaired code: 6/6 pass (work/harness-remote-mobile/native-capture/green-unit). Compiled native, renderer stamped ce96c3b7 by verify stamp: CI=1 HARNESS_VERIFY=1 HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR=work/harness-remote-mobile/native-capture/green-native/evidence HARNESS_VERIFY_REVISION=a3a99834 TAKE_SCREENSHOT=true bun x playwright test tests/e2e/native-desktop.spec.ts: 1 passed (14.4s). Without evidence dir or TAKE_SCREENSHOT: 1 passed (13.5s). Eight PNGs inspected: Designs, expected commit and approval, decoded image and thumbnail. Dirty test-source rehearsal, not an a3 record.

Isolated: reintroducing the a3 ordering (evidence before readiness, swallowed decode) via module swap makes the unchanged guard fail 6/6; restoring native-capture.ts passes 6/6. Logs and hashes: work/harness-remote-mobile/native-capture/red-unit, work/harness-remote-mobile/native-capture/green-unit, work/harness-remote-mobile/native-capture/test-hashes.sha256.
